sections.heading: What is trending: “the witcher 3”
paragraphs: “the witcher 3” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for BR (snapshot taken 2026-08-25T20:45:27+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 1,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Eurogamer.pt, Omelete, Project N. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered anunciado” — Eurogamer.pt

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:10:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-25T20:45:27+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-25T20:46:36+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
